claims.text: Masked Document Generation (MDG) is a task that learns to recover a document with a masked span of tokens.
MDG is one of the pre-training tasks designed for sequence-to-sequence models, alongside Sentence Reordering and Next Sentence Generation.
The goal of MDG is to predict the original text from which tokens have been masked.
